# Purpose
This header defines the metadata for three deduplication metrics used by the metrics system. Each `FD_METRICS_COUNTER_*` macro gives the metric offset, name, type, description, and converter for one counter: `dedup_transaction_bundle_peer_failure`, `dedup_transaction_dedup_failure`, and `dedup_gossiped_votes_received`. The file includes the base metrics definitions and the metric enum definitions, and it declares the `FD_METRICS_DEDUP` array with `FD_METRICS_DEDUP_TOTAL` set to `3UL`. The comment at the top states that `gen_metrics.py` generates the file and that it must not be edited by hand.
